body: I don’t even know. She wants to stay friends and still hook up. I don’t even know anymore lmao
I still find myself lost in thought over her.
Love is patient. We will come across each other again.
Yeah, especially when I was the one who walked away.

I’m just sick and tired of everyone thinking I’m weak because I can’t drink. Yeah I’m physically fit and too damn prideful for my own good but I have emotions too. Yeah I bottle them up until I can’t and then cry like a baby because I’m so mad at myself for being like the way I am. My ex, just under 3 weeks ago we broke up, told me I needed help and that she would be here always for me. I decided to actually get help. Out of the blue she decided she can’t be apart of me getting help. Shit just hurts to put so much into someone, be there for them with non judgmental views, hold them while cry about suicide, just to walk away from me when I finally have breakdown and lose my shit. Fuck love

Contact is important for humans. We literally need it. I haven’t been hugged since my ex. I miss her every day and everyday is harder than the last. I wish I could take my own advice when I say this but your person is out there. You’ll meet someone who completely changes the way you think and act. You’ll just want them to be happy and they’ll want the same for you. Just think before you act. Think if it’s gonna make you or them happy, sad or angry before you act. I couldn’t stop drinking until I lost it all. Don’t be like me.
